title: QUIZ - 23
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Calculate an average rate of change from two data points over time
questions.question: A car's odometer reads 48 km at t = 5 hours and 84 km at t = 8 hours. What is the average rate of change of distance with respect to time (in km/h)?
questions.explanation: Rate of change = (change in distance) / (change in time) = (84 - 48) / (8 - 5) = 36/3 = 12 km/h.
questions.hint: Divide the change in the quantity by the change in time.

questions.learningObjective: Compute a unit rate by dividing a total quantity by the number of units
questions.question: If words of 48 corresponds to 6 minutes, what is the unit rate per minute?
questions.explanation: Unit rate = total \(\div\) quantity \(= 48 \div 6 = 8\) per minute.
questions.hint: Divide the total amount by the number of units to find the rate per single unit.
